sourceOnlyFacts: Build for the selected record requires a non-empty Goal and non-empty criteria; otherwise prepareJob throws an English internal message. The pre-Build screen never says Goal and Criterion are required (Q2 PARTLY_SUPPORTED consistent).
Goal and criteria are component-local state, reset when the record panel remounts; this explains the empty fields at W4 but durability is not claimed.
Goal and criteria are sent in the CREATE_JOB request at Build together with the seven-field export request; the screen does not say how they relate to the HTML content.
The Stop control is rendered only while a build is running, so it cannot be seen before Build (Q7 PARTLY_SUPPORTED consistent).
Selected branch shows the local-profile disclosure only when the capabilities read reports a local synthetic boundary; the generic branch always shows the generic disclosure (matches cp2 versus cp3).
The record-row button toggles selection of the record, so the same button opens and closes the panel; it does not export (matches F1).
